fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Florida Power & Light Company and stock promotion; discussion of extending the Jockey Club racing season and a humorous letter about the Hialeah track; coverage of municipal court sentencing and criticism from a Baltimore newspaper; a letter/petition from prisoners in the Dade County stockade about food costs and conditions; commentary on railroad crossing safety and express delivery practices; society and entertainment notes and advertisements. Also features a bridge column by Sidney S. Lenz and a poem/feature by John Kimble.
